_meta._note: Chapter 27 final test (ch27-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions on the proposal blueprint: choosing a preposition in context (2), separate vs joined forms (2), contextual meaning (2), preposition + pronoun with its referent (3), Quran reading (3: 17:1, 2:2, 5:11). Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes. Rebuilt 2026-10-02 in the proposal harvest (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md) from Docs/proposals/chapter-27-content-proposal.md and its review amendments: eight common prepositions in context — فِي، عَلَى، مِنْ، إِلَى retrieved from Chapters 2/21 with a local model of the genitive after a preposition; joined بِـ / لِـ with the real spelling (لِـ + الـ → لِلْـ, لِلَّهِ; بِالْقَلَمِ keeps the alif); عَنْ and joined كَـ; prepositions with attached pronouns. Every hook now contains its lesson's preposition (Al-Kawthar and Al-Kafirun removed; the false hidden لِـ in رَبِّ removed; 'every preposition merges with الـ' removed). Not built: the proposal's separate Quran-reading lesson — its 5:11 excerpt sits in Lesson 4 — so ch27-l05 stays the review.
